title: State loneliness is associated with emotional hypervigilance in daily life: A network analysis
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Participants were not screened for neurological or psychiatric disorders; - Limited number of variables used; - Did not measure social interactions and contexts; - Stationary assumption of variables for multi-level VAR modeling might not hold; - Observational data only, no experimental design for causal interpretation
notes: The paper does not explicitly mention preregistration. Code and data are declared available in supplementary materials. The network visualization used the 'Fruchterman-Reingold' algorithm, but the specific package version for visualization is not stated in the text.
